At most once a day, when you open the app.
Playback needs no account and no network. Your music and covers stay on this phone.
Vesqen sends usage statistics at most once a day, with no ID attached, to learn which phones it runs on. They contain only:
Android version, manufacturer, model and system build
Whether a connected USB audio device offers the official bit-perfect path
Whether a USB audio device was connected in the last 7 days
Whether this is the first time today, this week and this month
They never include a device or install ID, your location, your music or what you listen to. The server keeps no IP addresses, only daily totals, for 90 days.
You can turn this off in Settings at any time.
This setting can’t be saved right now.
Vesqen has paused usage statistics, so nothing is sent for now. Your setting stays as it is, and sending resumes when the pause ends.
